notes: Free-living human activity recognition dataset. 151 participants, ~24h each; 3883 hours total wrist-worn accelerometer data, 2562 hours annotated. Device: Axivity AX3 tri-axial accelerometer worn on the DOMINANT WRIST, sampled at 100 Hz, +-8g range. Ground-truth labels derived from a wearable camera (Vicon Autographer / body camera worn during daytime) plus sleep diaries, annotated at 30-second resolution. Collected 2014-2016 (Oxford). Two-to-three orders of magnitude larger than prior public HAR datasets. Label sets: fine-grained (~200 activities via CompendiumOfPhysicalActivities/MET codes) plus coarse Willetts (6-class) and Walmsley (4-class: sleep, sedentary, light, MVPA) schemes. Dataset DOI: 10.5287/bodleian:NGx0JOMP5 (ORA), download capture24.zip ~6.4GB of .csv files. Analysis/loader code: https://github.com/OxWearables/capture24 (formerly activityMonitoring/capture24). An arXiv preprint (arXiv:2402.19229, 4 pages) also exists; paper.pdf here is the full 11-page published Scientific Data version. Verified 2026-07-02.
